title: The Evidence-Based Guide to AI: When to Use It, When to Stop, and How to Tell the Difference
headings: **Part One: When Not to Use It**
**1. Not when you are trying to learn something.**
**2. Not when the process is the point.**
**3. Not when you need to remember something.**
**4. Not when you are emotionally vulnerable.**
**5. Not when other people’s lives are affected by the output.**
**6. Not when you are forming your own opinion.**
**7. Not when accountability is the service.**
**8. Not when making an irreversible decision.**
**9. Not when the skill is core to who you are professionally.**
**10. Not when you do not know enough to check it.**
**11. When you are an expert, and you know what right looks like.**
**12. When the task is repetitive and well defined.**
coverage: opening + one cue-ranked passage + headings; partial inspection
